sections.title: Habit and range
sections.text: Cunninghamia lanceolata, China fir, is a large evergreen conifer native to China and cultivated for reforestation and timber. It commonly reaches about 20–30 m, sometimes taller. It has a conical outline and stiff, narrow, lance-shaped leaves arranged around the branchlets.

sections.title: Cones and plate
sections.text: Male and female cones are separate; the mature woody cones bear scales. The plate matches the needle-like leaves and cones. Despite its common name, it is not a fir in the genus Abies.
